metadata.primary_result: 3O7L is a source-mapped PKA/phospholamban peptide positive for review-only stress when legacy ANP PB is treated as the source-declared AMP-PNP terminal atom: phospholamban Ser21 OG is 5.930 Angstrom from ANP PB with local Mg nearby. It is not a folded-protein substrate positive.

citation.title: Dynamics connect substrate recognition to catalysis in protein kinase A.

gamma_transfer_geometry.gamma_atom_naming_note: Legacy ANP atom naming in 3O7L has PA/PB and no PG; PB is treated as the source-declared AMP-PNP terminal gamma-equivalent atom for this review-only artifact.
